items.description: LEGOLAND California Resort is a theme park located in Carlsbad, California. It features rides, shows, and attractions based on the popular LEGO toy bricks.
facts: First LEGOLAND park in the USA.
Designed for families with young children.
Includes a water park and aquarium.

items.description: Grand Teton National Park in Wyoming is known for its stunning Teton Range, pristine lakes, and abundant wildlife. It offers dramatic mountain scenery and outdoor recreation.
SeaWorld Orlando is a marine zoological park and theme park in Orlando, Florida. It features marine animal shows, aquariums, and thrill rides.
facts: Offers roller coasters and water rides.
Committed to animal rescue and rehabilitation.

items.description: Zion National Park in Utah is famous for its massive sandstone cliffs, narrow canyons, and unique geological formations. The Virgin River carves through its impressive landscape.
facts: Features the iconic Angels Landing hike.
Home to a diverse plant and animal life.

items.description: Great Smoky Mountains National Park, straddling the border of North Carolina and Tennessee, is the most visited national park in the United States. It is known for its ancient mountains and diverse plant and animal life.
Knott's Berry Farm is a 57-acre theme park in Buena Park, California. It began as a small berry farm and roadside stand, evolving into a major amusement destination.
facts: Opened in 1920s as a berry farm.

items.description: The Colorado Plateau is a vast, arid region of the Western United States characterized by unique geological features such as canyons, mesas, and buttes. It spans parts of four states.
facts: Covers parts of Utah, Colorado, Arizona, New Mexico.
Known for iconic red rock landscapes.
Includes Grand Canyon and Zion National Park.

items.description: The Sierra Madre Occidental is a major mountain range system in western Mexico, extending into the southwestern United States. It forms a significant part of the North American Cordillera.
facts: Source of many rivers flowing to the Pacific.

items.description: The Chisos Mountains are a mountain range located in Big Bend National Park in West Texas. They are the only mountain range in North America entirely contained within a national park.
facts: Located in Big Bend National Park.
Home to diverse desert and mountain flora.

items.description: The Olympic Mountains are a mountain range on the Olympic Peninsula of western Washington State. They are part of the Pacific Coast Ranges.
